title: Segregated Bubbling Solutions for a Critical Schrödinger System of Brezis--Nirenberg Type with Sublinear Competitive Coupling
summary: We construct segregated bubbling solutions for a two-component critical Schrödinger system of Brezis--Nirenberg type in a smooth bounded domain $Ω\subset\mathbb R^N$, $N\geq5$, with any fixed competitive coupling $β 0$, the system admits a nonnegative weak solution with both components nontrivial. Each component has a single-bubble profile and concentrates at one of the prescribed points. Each component also vanishes identically in a ball centered at the other concentration point; after rescaling by the natural bubble length, the radius of this ball tends to infinity.
